main.description: Returns badges issued to the authenticated user, organized by display slot. Also indicates which badges are currently selected in the user's chat profile.

streamer.description: DID of the streamer channel to compute the server badge against.

server.description: Computed server badge (streamer, mod, or bot) for the given streamer context. Absent if the user has no server role.

streamer.description: Streamer-issued badges (e.g. VIP) available to the user.

user.description: Globally-issued cosmetic badges (e.g. event) available to the user.
